g.text: GND_24V and GND are NOT connected: this is the isolation barrier.

g.desc: GND_24V and GND are NOT connected: this is the isolation barrier.

g.text: Button pressed, wire cut or 24 V lost -> no current -> pin HIGH = STOP. F1 protects the 24 V wires going out to the buttons.

g.desc: Button pressed, wire cut or 24 V lost -> no current -> pin HIGH = STOP. F1 protects the 24 V wires going out to the buttons.

g.text: Loop current = (24 V - 1.2 V opto - 2.0 V LED) / 3.0 k = 6.9 mA. Each 1.5 k (1/4 W): 72 mW at 24 V, 109 mW at 28.8 V.

g.desc: Loop current = (24 V - 1.2 V opto - 2.0 V LED) / 3.0 k = 6.9 mA. Each 1.5 k (1/4 W): 72 mW at 24 V, 109 mW at 28.8 V.

g.text: Two e-stop inputs, 24 V loop through PC817 - shield for Arduino UNO R4 WiFi / UNO Q

g.desc: Two e-stop inputs, 24 V loop through PC817 - shield for Arduino UNO R4 WiFi / UNO Q

g.text: Pull-ups go to IOREF: 5 V on the UNO R4 WiFi, 3.3 V on the UNO Q. Never to the 5V pin. Sketch: pinMode(D2/D3, INPUT).
